Container.Name: nimbus
Container.Overview:
Nimbus is a self-hosted, multi-user dashboard for your homelab. It checks whether your services are online, shows widgets next to them and puts live numbers from your apps (Sonarr, Radarr, qBittorrent, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, Proxmox, Jellyfin, Home Assistant, Uptime Kuma) on their tiles.
Nimbus needs PostgreSQL. Install the "nimbus-postgres" template from the same repository first and use the same database password in both.
Create your account when you first open Nimbus; the first account becomes the admin. The uploads folder also holds the generated secrets, so include it in your appdata backup.

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: Icons, avatars, wallpapers and the generated JWT_SECRET and ENCRYPTION_KEY. Back it up.

Config.Name: Database host
Config.Description: IP address of your Unraid server, or the container name nimbus-postgres when both containers are on the same custom Docker network

Config.Name: Database port
Config.Description: Host port of the nimbus-postgres container

Config.Name: Database password
Config.Description: The password you set in the nimbus-postgres container. Letters, digits, - and _ only.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address you open Nimbus at, for example https://nimbus.example.com. Used in password reset emails and OAuth redirects.

Config.Name: JWT secret
Config.Description: Signs sessions, at least 32 characters. Leave empty and Nimbus generates one in the uploads folder.

Config.Name: Encryption key
Config.Description: Encrypts integration credentials (openssl rand -base64 32). Leave empty and Nimbus generates one in the uploads folder.
